column1: # manifests/di-build-markers.tsv -- d-i build-marker records accepted by
# d-i writes "Package: debian-installer" with the image build stamp as its
# Version (cdrom-<variant>-<YYYYMMDD>-<HH:MM:SS>) and no Architecture into the
# installer initrd's dpkg status.  No archive index can carry a build stamp and
# the record has no bytes of its own, so build/forky-provenance.py clears it only
# when (name, version) matches a row here EXACTLY and the ISO being scanned is the
# row's substrate_sha256, which must also be the sha256 pinned in
# manifests/base.pin.  A re-pinned substrate therefore needs new rows (measured
# from its provenance-predict FAIL lines); every other record keeps its hash check.
# columns (TAB): name version arch substrate_sha256 reason
